title: Provenance
description: Reusable lineage block carried across bundle, canonical, and projection boundaries.

tenant_id.description: Tenant owning the content. Public data uses a reserved non-null tenant such as tenant_public.

corpus_id.description: Corpus or library boundary within which identity resolution and access control occur.

scope_type.description: Visibility and sharing model of the content.

source_version_id.description: Approved frozen source version used for acquisition.

run_id.description: Acquisition run that produced the input bundle.

source_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot of one upstream item or record.

artifact_id.description: Primary artifact ID when one artifact is the canonical anchor for a document.

document_id.description: Stable logical document identity within the corpus.

document_revision.description: Monotonic published canonical revision for the logical document.
